notes: CTO (R. Singh): 'We need sub-50ms median for first-stage recall, 150-250ms for full rerank at 500 qps peak for product search.'
Primary constraint is index scale: target 300M -> long-term 1B vectors. Wants benchmark at 1B before final commit.
Cost target guidance from biz ops: unit cost target ~$0.0005 - $0.001 per query (end-to-end) — very cost sensitive at scale.
Wants model flexibility: dense embeddings in float16/8-bit quantized, ability to fallback to smaller models during peak.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logs for all inference calls; data residency for EU customers (split indices).
Ops note: on-prem preferred for PCI-adjacent workloads; VPC for other regions; must run monthly retention purge workflows and provide retention controls.
Quote from Head of Search: 'If we can hit the target latency & cost at 500-1k qps we can replace our existing vector infra.'
requirements_summary: Massive-scale vector store (100M -> 1B+), two-stage retrieval + cross-encoder reranking, sub-50ms median recall latency, stable 99th pctl SLA, predictable unit economics, VPC/on-prem deployment with SSO/KMS/audit logs, ability to run quantized models and smart batching/caching to reduce per-query cost.
technical_constraints: Index size: ingest pipeline must handle incremental ingestion of 300M vectors in POC and scale to 1B within 12 months.
Throughput: sustained 500 qps with burst to 1k qps; reranker concurrency requirements for cross-encoder hits ~20% of queries.
Latency: first-stage recall median <50ms, 99th pctl end-to-end target <250ms for typical queries.
Cost optimization: aggressive batching, prefix/KV caching, quantized embeddings (4/8-bit) to meet ~$0.0005/query target.
Operational: on-prem deployment must run air-gapped verification checks; VPC deployment requires transit gateway peering and NSA-like audit trails.
